recommendation.reason: 需要跨 Agent 交接研究判断的团队可用离线样例验证一轮文件交付。相比把判断只写在对话里，流程可以绑定上下文并拒绝缺少反方证据的产物。若源材料或回执无法核对，应停止采用输出并退回人工文档复核。

# clawock > 为外部 AI Agent 提供投资研究的证据组织、决策校验和结果复盘流程。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[KCNyu/clawock](https://github.com/KCNyu/clawock) - **版本号**：未声明（[固定提交 fcb35fd5a67904a8a3f62c9da62da76828d87d50](https://github.com/KCNyu/clawock/tree/fcb35fd5a67904a8a3f62c9da62da76828d87d50)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-04（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定源码支持发布门槛与后验输入检查。没有运行模型、市场数据、宿主或真实账户。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：研究人员希望跨 Agent 保留判断、引用、反方意见和结果。 - **亮点**：[Q02](#research-q02) 在 Agent 外核验上下文证书、方向性证据及失效条件，可拒绝缺失的结构。 - **思考**：[Q03](#research-q03) 有效回执和方向评价各有边界，不能由此推断市场数据真实、资金实际成交或投资收益。 - **建议**：[Q03](#research-q03) 对照文档和材料证书的异构 Agent 移交，测复核错误和工时。若均无改善就停止。 采用建议：[Q03](#research-q03) 仅用离线模拟材料测试可审计交接，输入和回执对不上即退回人工复核。 ## 核心贡献 [Q02](#research-q02) 在 Agent 外核验上下文证书、方向性证据及失效条件，可拒绝缺失的结构。 ## 关键质疑 [Q03](#research-q03) 有效回执和方向评价各有边界，不能由此推断市场数据真实、资金实际成交或投资收益。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q03](#research-q03) 对照文档和材料证书的异构 Agent 移交，测复核错误和工时。若均无改善就停止。 离线回放修改输入、无反方证据、错误观察时间和发布失败，比较人工复核结果。 ## 场景与替代办法 研究人员希望跨 Agent 保留判断、引用、反方意见和结果。 普通笔记或表格可以保存判断，工作流增加程序化输入绑定和验证。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Python 3.11+ 和工作区 | 必需 | 准备及发布文件 | 不能使用 CLI | | 外部 Agent | 正式流程需 | 生成判断产物 | 用离线样例校验文件协议 | | 可信观察来源 | 评价需 | 记录后验输入 | 保留缺口 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 准备 | 操作者固定工作区上下文 | 记录请求证书 | | 发布 | Agent 写判断，操作者调用 CLI | 缺材料时拒绝 | | 复盘 | 操作者提供后验样本 | 核对时间、币种和方向 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | 运行资源未知 | 配置独立工作区 | 需 Python 和样例 | | 持续 | 数据与模型费用未知 | 验证证据与后验标签 | 真实源与计划独立 | | 失败 | 重跑成本未知 | 核对证书和产物 | 恢复性能未测 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 可交接 | 证书和产物清单 | 实际复核节时 | | 结构门槛 | 两方证据和失效条件 | 事实质量和收益 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：外部 Agent 的研究判断如何绑定材料并接受独立回看？ ### Q01 · 根仓解决什么交付问题，DSH 子包承担什么？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 做研究复盘的团队可以把各 Agent 产生的判断和证据统一写为本地可移交文档，而不是把结果只留在对话。根仓定义 Python CLI 和文件协议，模型、会话与工具在外部 Agent；DSH 的仪表板和任务队列是 examples 中另一个安装包，作者的券商配置与调度也不随根包部署。与自行维护表格相比，根工具带来的主要增量是输入、判断和后验评价在换 Agent 时仍可复核。若只做一次临时摘要，普通文档也能满足，结构化准备成本未必值得。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[pyproject.toml:5-16](https://github.com/KCNyu/clawock/blob/fcb35fd5a67904a8a3f62c9da62da76828d87d50/pyproject.toml#L5-L16) Python 根发行物、版本与要求。
查看原文（12行） ```text [project] name = "clawock" version = "0.4.2" description = "Investment workflows for AI agents: evidence, opposing cases, and outcomes checked by Python." readme = "README.md" requires-python = ">=3.11" license = { file = "LICENSE" } authors = [{ name = "Shengyu Li" }] keywords = [ "agent", "llm", "decision-workflow", "harness", "portfolio", "provenance", "reconciliation", "evidence", "audit", "mcp", "plugins", "strategy", "walk-forward", ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[pyproject.toml:114-121](https://github.com/KCNyu/clawock/blob/fcb35fd5a67904a8a3f62c9da62da76828d87d50/pyproject.toml#L114-L121) 根仓命令注册。 ```text [project.scripts] clawock = "clawock.cli:main" clawock-brief-watchdog = "clawock.harness.brief_watchdog:main" clawock-report-watchdog = "clawock.harness.report_watchdog:main" clawock-intraday-watchdog = "clawock.harness.intraday_watchdog:main" clawock-cron-heartbeat = "clawock.automation.cron_heartbeat:main" clawock-workflow-outcomes = "clawock.automation.workflow_outcomes:main" clawock-intraday-delta = "clawock.harness.intraday_delta:main" ``` **依据 3 · 作者声明**：[README.md:79-96](https://github.com/KCNyu/clawock/blob/fcb35fd5a67904a8a3f62c9da62da76828d87d50/README.md#L79-L96) 作者描述外部 Agent 和文件协议。
查看原文（18行） ```text ## Any harness, one decision contract that accumulates evidence clawock was never inside the chat. It is one skill (`investment-decision`), one command line tool and a handful of files in your workspace, so any agent that can read a file, write a file and run a command can use it: **Claude Code / Codex / OpenClaw / DeepSeek Harness / your own script**. Switch from Claude Code to Codex next month and, with the same workspace, the history comes with you. Your agent keeps its model, conversation, memory, research tools, credentials and permissions; clawock never starts a model. It pins down what went in, checks what came out, marks the result later and keeps the record: | File | Written by | What it holds | |---|---|---| | `request.json` | clawock, when you run `clawock run prepare` | the material for this decision, with a fingerprint of every document so it cannot be swapped afterwards | | `decision.json` | your agent | its answer: the case for, the case against, the action, and what would prove it wrong | | `plan.json` | the author's setup, every morning | the same answer for a whole portfolio, one entry per position | | `decisions.jsonl` | the author's setup | the public ledger: one line per decision, with the result added once code has marked it | | `outcome.json` | you, once the waiting period is over | the prices you saw and where you got them | | `evaluation.json` | clawock, when you run `clawock workflow evaluate` | whether the direction was right. It is not money made | **The model itself does not change; the record does.** Before the next plan the agent can review earlier judgments and their results, and with enough evaluated history the author's setup also checks how reliable earlier confidence figures were. A new workspace starts empty: you build the history by recording decisions and evaluating them.

```
**依据 4 · 作者声明**：[README.md:247-262](https://github.com/KCNyu/clawock/blob/fcb35fd5a67904a8a3f62c9da62da76828d87d50/README.md#L247-L262) 另有 DSH 子包与主机配置。
查看原文（16行） ````text **Decision Mind** traces a real fill through **plan → execution → T+1 → P&L**: what the plan said, what you did, where the price was one session later and what it earned or lost. A fill with no plan, or not yet graded, says so; a new workspace has no trades to show. Ask "Can I add to 0700.HK?" and the investment skill walks the agent through the same steps as above.

```bash python -m pip install clawock dsh plugin --profile web add clawock-dsh mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills cp -r ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/clawock-dsh/skills/investment-decision ~/.dsh/skills/ ``` Restart the web profile to load it. Queue controls also need the host runner; without it the panel still shows provider allowances and balances. For the chat commands, add the installed package directory to OpenClaw's `plugins.load.paths` and restart the gateway. [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/clawock-dsh) · [installation and queue setup](https://github.com/KCNyu/clawock/blob/master/examples/dsh/packages/clawock-dsh/README.md). ## Under the hood These diagrams show the author's configured account: market-data access, holdings, stored decisions, scheduled jobs and delivery destinations. Installing clawock gives you the commands and workflows; a daily service like this one needs those inputs and jobs configured too. ````
#### 缺口 - 没有独立用户流程样本 **影响**：无法衡量移交节时或采用门槛 **进一步探讨**：让两种 Agent 对同一材料先后接手，统计复核中可直接定位的输入比例 ### Q02 · 如何阻止输入漂移与缺反方证据的输出？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、缺陷与关键质疑、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 CLI 准备命令生成工作区下的请求原件，记录运行/产物代号和证书；发布时重读任务、输出路径、元数据和工作流，重新组装上下文并比较证书，内容漂移时拒绝。AgentRun 从所选工作流获取 validator，结构验证不通过即给 rejected 回执；通过后把证书和产物列表交给 FilesystemStore。投资判断 validator 分开计数支持及反对证据，要求两边引用相应方向并列可推翻条件。它约束论证结构与材料绑定，不能判断引用对事实的解释是否正确，也不证明外部源完整。相比只让模型自述信心，规则对格式缺口可独立拒绝，但语义复核仍需要人。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/clawock/cli.py:37-54](https://github.com/KCNyu/clawock/blob/fcb35fd5a67904a8a3f62c9da62da76828d87d50/src/clawock/cli.py#L37-L54) 入口写请求并限本地权限。
查看原文（18行） ```text def _run_prepare(args) -> int: from clawock.harness import AgentRun from clawock.harness.config import load_request from clawock.publish.store import write_generation try: request = load_request(args.workspace) prepared = AgentRun().prepare(request) state = request.workspace / ".clawock" / "work" / prepared.run_id / "request.json" payload = prepared.as_dict() payload["request_file"] = str(state) write_generation({ str(state): json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", }) state.chmod(0o600) except (ValueError, OSError) as exc: print(str(exc), file=sys.stderr) return 1 ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/clawock/cli.py:74-101](https://github.com/KCNyu/clawock/blob/fcb35fd5a67904a8a3f62c9da62da76828d87d50/src/clawock/cli.py#L74-L101) 拒绝身份或上下文漂移。
查看原文（28行） ```text raise ValueError( f"prepared request must live under {state_root}; `clawock run prepare` " f"writes one to {state_root}//request.json — pass that path") payload = json.loads(state_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if not isinstance(payload, dict) or payload.get("schema_version") != 1: raise ValueError("prepared request requires schema_version 1") run_id = payload.get("run_id") generation_id = payload.get("generation_id") if not all( isinstance(value, str) and len(value) == 32 and all(char in "0123456789abcdef" for char in value) for value in (run_id, generation_id) ): raise ValueError("prepared request has invalid run/generation IDs") if payload.get("task") != request.task: raise ValueError("workspace task changed after this run was prepared") if payload.get("output_directory") != str(request.output_directory): raise ValueError("workspace output directory changed after this run was prepared") if payload.get("metadata") != dict(request.metadata): raise ValueError("workspace metadata changed after this run was prepared") if payload.get("workflow", {}) != dict(request.workflow): raise ValueError("workspace workflow changed after this run was prepared") context = assemble_explicit(request.workspace, request.context_files) supplied_context = payload.get("context") if not isinstance(supplied_context, dict) or ( supplied_context.get("certificate") != context.certificate() ): raise ValueError("workspace context changed after this run was prepared") ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[src/clawock/cli.py:116-130](https://github.com/KCNyu/clawock/blob/fcb35fd5a67904a8a3f62c9da62da76828d87d50/src/clawock/cli.py#L116-L130) CLI 实际调用发布并返回状态。
查看原文（15行） ```text raise ValueError(f"duplicate artifact name: {name}") artifacts[name] = source.read_text(encoding="utf-8") prepared = PreparedRun(request, context, run_id, generation_id) receipt = AgentRun().publish( prepared, artifacts, FilesystemStore(request.output_directory / run_id), ) result = receipt.as_dict() except (ValueError, OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc: print(str(exc), file=sys.stderr) return 1 print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)) return 0 if receipt.status == "published" else 1 ```
**依据 4 · 源码核查**：[src/clawock/harness/agent_run.py:130-183](https://github.com/KCNyu/clawock/blob/fcb35fd5a67904a8a3f62c9da62da76828d87d50/src/clawock/harness/agent_run.py#L130-L183) validator 和拒绝路径与发布清单。

It is a `watch` scored as `passive_stance` with `fill_assumed: false`: a score for the holding judgment, not profit or loss from a new trade. Every call is settled this way and published, wins, losses and ungradeable alike; nobody adjusts a result afterwards. - **Saying the same thing every day counts once.** From 2026-07-29 to 2026-10-08 the brief said "hold and watch" on Goldwind 45 times. That is one result (`ep-f31982c6d511`), not 45. - **A call that cannot be graded stays on the ledger.** On 2026-10-01 Hong Kong was closed, so record `dec-143614125e34` has `outcome: unknown`, `status: not_evaluable` and `session_reason: market_closed`. - **What you did is recorded apart from what the plan said.** `clawock mark-followed` marks each call followed or not. **The next decision starts from this record.** The 2026-10-12 brief printed the Goldwind call under "Yesterday's results" with `loss` beside it, and the model reads how reliable its earlier confidence figures were, using earlier dates only. In your own harness: observed prices go in `outcome.json`, and `clawock workflow evaluate` writes `evaluation.json`, which checks direction, not realized profit.

Results or a rejected publication can support a proposal to change the evidence requirements: only the required evidence count and the confidence limit without a primary source, never strategies, trading rules or the skill.
